evidence.text: Reserved compute 50 thousand hours costs 300 total, USD 6/hour. X used 18 thousand hours; Y used 22 thousand; no other usage.

Unused reservation remains payable; shared administration 42. No other costs.

question: Can optimal reservation capacity next year be determined from 40 thousand consumed hours this year?

short: Historic usage is not future demand.
